outline: 產品設計專案包含研究與設計。設計專案透過工業設計的理論、方法及程序，以研究的手段形成設計決策，或以實證的方式將研究成果應用於設計實務。設計專案之設計成果必須建立在相關的研究基礎上。
schedule:
WEEK/  PROJECT
*PHASE 1:  DESIGN PROJECT*
01 Introduction + Design Thinking (submit 2 opportunities by next Wednesday 11pm)
02 Systematic Innovation + Real-Win-Worth-it (rate 50 opportunities by next Wednesday11pm)
03 Customer Needs Analysis (assigned groups explore top opportunities)
04 Project Selection (present and select opportunities to form project teams)
05 Product Specifications + Scrum Process (mission statement)
06 Creativity and Concept Generation
07 Prototyping (customer needs and competitive analysis)
08 Concept Selection
09 Experience and Service Design
10 Review and Report 1 (concept models, selection, and uncertainties)
*PHASE 2: DESIGN REPORT*
11~16 Prepare for Report Based on the Design Review and Theories.
17 Final Design Review (final presentation and prototype demonstration)
18 Feedback and Evaluations Peer Eval 2
assessment:
30% for Class participation
40% for Project performance
30% for Report performance
